{"id":1933413147,"question_id":1800,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772264179,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1933413147/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Concatenation of Consecutive Binary Numbers","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n\n    string to_binary(int n)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            ans.push_back((n % 2) + '0');\n            n /= 2;\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n    \n    int contri(string &s , ll &power)\n    {\n        ll sum = 0;\n\n        for(int i = s.size()-1 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            int digit = s[i]- '0';\n\n            if(digit == 1)\n            {\n                long long val = 1;\n                for(int j = 0 ; j < power ; j++) val = (val * 2) % mod;\n                sum = (sum + val) % mod;\n            }\n            power++;   \n        }\n        return sum % mod;\n    }\n\n    int concatenatedBinary(int n) {\n        ll tsum = 0;\n        ll power = 0;\n        for(int i = n ; i>= 1 ; i--)\n        {\n            string binary = to_binary(i);\n            int total_contribution = contri(binary , power);\n            tsum += total_contribution;\n        }\n    return tsum % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"concatenation-of-consecutive-binary-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1747}
